verification_method: Wix upload returned HTTP 200 and an upload ID. Live read-back fetched the new research page, catalog page and homepage; the page title, page routes and GitHub links were observed. The public extractor returned partial page text, so exact topic-by-topic archive-level validation remains incomplete.
automation_boundary: Connected Wix upload/read-back was used for this sync. GitHub Actions has no Wix credentials; scheduled ChatGPT automation may use the connected Wix tool, but must record the actual run and read-back result.
note: Twenty-seven catalog entries are published as 18 existing entries plus a 9-entry fractal-research supplement. Publication status is not semantic verification.
